text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a gain felt rewarding, but that satisfaction is not evidence that I can time prices; I should judge trades by my plan, not by whether they lock in a gain.","My account has declined from its peak, but short-term losses are no reason to chase a recovery or abandon diversification; I should keep risk aligned with my goals.","Prices move randomly, so daily checking and frequent trading do not give me an edge; I should avoid reacting to recent changes and make only deliberate, plan-based decisions."]}
